import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    ok = True
    while m != 0:
        d = m % w
        if d == 0 or d == 1:
            if d == 1:
                m = (m - 1) // w
            else:
                m = m // w
        elif d == w - 1:
            m = (m + 1) // w
        else:
            ok = False
            break
    sys.stdout.write("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
